test_cases.name: No secrets in source
test_cases.input_setup: Scan all production python source files with regex secret patterns
test_cases.expected_result: Zero hardcoded API keys or credentials found in src/
test_cases.evidence: Scanned all python files in src/; zero hardcoded secrets detected

test_cases.name: .env.example safe
test_cases.input_setup: Parse .env.example and inspect values for credential patterns
test_cases.expected_result: Contains only safe placeholders and non-secret defaults
test_cases.evidence: Verified 66 config lines in .env.example; all contain safe placeholders

test_cases.name: Key Vault client initialization
test_cases.input_setup: Enable USE_KEY_VAULT=true with valid vault URL and invoke _build_client()
test_cases.evidence: SecretClient successfully initialized with DefaultAzureCredential and vault URL

test_cases.name: Secret caching TTL
test_cases.input_setup: Fetch same secret key multiple times
test_cases.expected_result: Second fetch served from cache; zero remote API calls
test_cases.evidence: Subsequent reads resolved instantly from in-memory cache without API call

test_cases.name: Missing secret error handling
test_cases.input_setup: Query non-existent secret name from Key Vault client
test_cases.expected_result: Returns None cleanly with informative error; zero PHI leak and no application crash
test_cases.evidence: Graceful handling of missing secret: ResourceNotFoundError: Secret missing_secret_xyz not found
